issue.title: [BUG] SolverSemiImplicit does not maintain rest pose of D6 joint with 2 angular dofs and non-zero ke on each dof
issue.verified_contract: A D6 joint initialized at its rest pose should maintain that pose without external forces. The posted CPU reproducer uses angular axes Y/Z, coordinates and targets (0.2, 0.4), one 0.001-second SemiImplicit step, drive stiffness 2, zero gravity, and zero attachment/angular-damping gains; eval_ik recovers joint velocities with absolute 1e-8 tolerance. It also includes a zero-drive-gain control.

pr.title: Fix SemiImplicit D6 drive angles for custom axes
pr.verified_description: The stated correction rotates relative orientation into the two-axis joint frame before decomposition, matching invert_2d_rotational_dofs. The test plan covers three axis pairs and adjacent joint-drive/joint-limit CPU tests. The report links issue #4540 as the minimal reproduction.

scope_result: Primary descriptions match the frozen original witness and expanded oracle; no runtime scope change was needed.
